examples.label: Core checklist
examples.command: # audit SUID/world-writable, absolute paths in cron+sudo, no cleartext creds, least-privilege groups, patch kernel

notes:
- Audit writable files/dirs and SUID binaries
- Use absolute paths in cron and sudoers entries
- No cleartext creds in world-readable files
- Clean home dirs and bash history
- Restrict low-priv users from modifying custom libraries
- Remove unneeded packages/services; apply SELinux
- Least-privilege sudo/group assignments
- Log valid+invalid logons; enforce strong passphrases (PAM /etc/security/opasswd)
- Periodic audits (Lynis); enable unattended-upgrades / yum-cron

recommended.note: The attacker-side counterpart to this checklist.

name: Reference - Linux Hardening Checklist
description: Defensive counterpart: the hardening measures that close the escalation paths in this module, plus Lynis for automated auditing.
